mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and a reduction in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a coordinated monetary and credit easing policy that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime characterized by housing starts above 1700 thousand units, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overheating and the risk of a housing bubble burst.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to a more aggressive monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and an increase in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-side contraction regime characterized by industrial production below 95% of its 12-month moving average, the S&P 500 tends to experience negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95% of 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals a healthy economy and higher corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
